cards.title: "Can You Just Leave It Here?" | Exyn CEO & COO Ben Williams ($EXYN)
cards.heading: "CAN YOU JUST LEAVE IT HERE?" | EXYN CEO & COO BEN WILLIAMS
cards.desc: What happens when a drone loses GPS, loses its radio link and has no map, deep underground? For Exyn Technologies, that is the starting point. CEO/COO Ben Williams sits down with Benny Shaw and JT Paterson from The Zero Hour Group, joined by Jeff Gabel and World Media White House Bureau Chief Kate Jones.

cards.title: Helicopter Lift.  Airplane Range. Zero Crew | EIVIE Founder & CEO Damjan Zabovnik
cards.heading: HELICOPTER LIFT.  AIRPLANE RANGE. ZERO CREW | EIVIE FOUNDER & CEO DAMJAN ZABOVNIK
cards.meta: 3D Printed Drone · Benny Shaw · Commercial UAV Expo 2026
cards.desc: Benny Shaw, CEO of The Zero Hour Group, walks the floor at Commercial UAV Expo 2026 in Las Vegas. He is in the coolest room in the world that week, and stops to see the coolest drone in the room. Damjan Zabovnik, founder and CEO of EIVIE, shows off a patent-pending circular wing, coaxial VTOL.

cards.title: Software That Makes Machines Smart
cards.heading: SOFTWARE THAT MAKES MACHINES SMART
cards.meta: Anduril Lattice · Ben Wolff · Benny Shaw
cards.desc: Palladyne AI (Nasdaq: PDYN) CEO Ben Wolff sits down with Benny Shaw and JT Paterson from The Zero Hour Group, joined by contributor Jeff Gabel, to talk about software that lets machines perceive, decide and react on their own, from industrial robot arms to drone swarms. This is the definition of autonomy versus automation.

cards.heading: DEFENSE NEVER ENDS: BAVOVNA & CSG AT AUSA 2026 | BAVOVNA'S CTO MAX PRASOLOV & CSE USA CEO PAUL LEMKE
cards.desc: Benny Shaw of The Zero Hour Group ( sat down with Max Prasolov, co-founder and CTO of Bavovna AI, and Paul Lemke, CEO of CSE USA, the U.S. member company of CSG (Czechoslovak Group) to discuss their recent partnership agreement to commercialize Bavovna’s technology throughout the world.

cards.title: Why Kopin Is Bringing MicroLED Home From China | Kopin CEO Michael Murray ($KOPN)
cards.heading: WHY KOPIN IS BRINGING MICROLED HOME FROM CHINA | KOPIN CEO MICHAEL MURRAY
cards.meta: AI Data Center · AUSA 2026 · AUSA Annual Meeting
cards.desc: Benny Shaw and Kate Jones of The Zero Hour Group ( walked the halls of the AUSA Annual Meeting in Washington, D.C. on October 13, 2026 with Michael Murray, CEO, President and Chairperson of Kopin. Kopin took no booth on the floor this year; it ran a private meeting suite instead due to more than 50 customer meetings in three days, with countries and programs Kopin could not easily fly to.

cards.title: Palantir x Ondas: The Defense AI Partnership That Changes Everything | CEO Eric Brock $ONDS
cards.heading: PALANTIR X ONDAS: THE DEFENSE AI PARTNERSHIP THAT CHANGES EVERYTHING | CEO ERIC BROCK
cards.meta: AUSA 2026 · AUSA Annual Meeting · Benny Shaw
cards.desc: Benny Shaw of The Zero Hour Group ( sat down with Ondas CEO Eric Brock at the AUSA Annual Meeting in Washington, D.C. on October 12, 2026, the same day Ondas announced its partnership with Palantir: Regna AI. Brock explains that Regna builds AI models for specific missions and helps customers run them inside their own environments, using Palantir's AIP platform and open-weight models.
